name: Context7 docs lookup
summary: Current library documentation from Upstash's hosted Context7 service, through the plugin in the official marketplace, plus a rule to send only library names and generic questions. The one allowed egress exception.

evidence.effect: fewer answers from stale API knowledge (expected, not measured)

killTest.hypothesis: Docs lookup helps on libraries changed after the model's training cutoff
killTest.pass: Pass-rate interval above 0 at a cost ratio no higher than 1.1
killTest.budget: 10 such tasks x 2 arms x 2 runs
killTest.ifFails: Stays opt-in, with the measured result shown

egress.default: library names and generic questions to mcp.context7.com (Upstash)
egress.optional: an API key, if the user sets CONTEXT7_API_KEY

revisit: the agent ships version-aware docs lookup
maintenance: Hosted service run by Upstash; plugin listed in the official marketplace.
